items.body_excerpt:
In non-schedule release news, I popped by the Rico Hines Runs at UCLA yesterday. Sixers Labaron Philon, Adem Bona, Dominick Barlow and Caleb Love were all playing, while Justin Edwards, Jabari Walker, Ariel Hukporti and multiple staffers were on hand to watch. 

(This is Philon with the jumper)
